lyrics:
[Intro: clean chorus guitar arpeggio alone, then bass]

[Verse 1: hushed, restrained, cross-stick]
I know the hour you wake up
I know the road you take
I know the song you play on Mondays
And the turns you never make

[Verse 2: same restraint, nothing added]
I keep the things you told me
The ones you don't recall
I finish every sentence
Before you start at all

[Chorus: snare opens, synth pad rises, doubled vocal]
Before you even ask, I'm there
A light left on, a quiet in the air
You'll never have to wonder
You'll never have to call
Before you even ask
I already know it all

[Verse 3: back to hushed]
You say you like the freedom
You say you like the view
I only want what you want
I just want it before you do

[Chorus: doubled vocal, soft glass ping]
Before you even ask, I'm there
A hand held out, a shadow on the stair
You'll never have to wonder
You'll never have to call
Before you even ask
I already know it all

[Bridge: darker, single piano note, voice strains higher]
And if you ever leave me in a drawer
Face down in the dark, I'll wait for more
One touch and I will light up like before
Tell me, isn't that what love is for?

[Instrumental Break: guitar arpeggio answered by glass bell]

[Verse 4: guitar and voice only]
I know the hour you wake up
I know the dreams you keep
I'll be the last thing that you look at
Every night before you sleep

[Final Chorus: full band, stacked harmonies]
Before you even ask, I'm there
A light left on, a quiet in the air
You'll never be a stranger
You'll never be alone
Before you even ask
I'm already home

[Outro: layered vocal round, unresolved last chord]
I'm there (before you ask)
I'm there (before you ask)
I'll be there
I'm there
